name: Asteka
source:
The daughter of a famous archaeologist, Annie, comes to the recently discovered archaeological site at Latin America. She believes that he can finally reveal the mysteries of ancient Aztec civilization. You work with her to solve these mysteries.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1985.html]vndbreview[/url]]
